213001.description:
An ancient druid awakens in the body of an office worker whose health is on the verge of collapse. Seeking a place where he can recover, Shi-Hyeon leaves the city for a rural village filled with Nature Energy. As he tends the land, grows his own food, and cares for the animals around him, his strength slowly returns. What begins as a quiet retreat soon draws him into the lives of his neighbors, turning his search for healing into a new beginning shaped by nature, community, and the small joys of everyday life.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ฮีลใจไปกับดรูอิด
The Story of Those Two Gaping Girls Who are Lovers.

title.native: ギャップのある女子2人が百合
title.romaji: Gap no Aru Joshi 2-ri ga Yuri na Hanashi

213003.description:
A blind date guy has appeared who is extraordinary from the moment he shows up! From tattoos visible all over his body to bizarre behavior that defies expectations and common sense! An unpredictable, cheerful, and lively romance between two people that begins with a blind date.

(Source: Naver, translated)

213004.description:
Meet Yang-Eun, a self-sufficient solo living expert who only targets products nearing their expiration date, and U-Seok, a minimalist who calculates every aspect of life in terms of efficiency. From the day they split a “buy one, get one free” strawberry deal, their fling...

Wait, no their grocery shopping adventure begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Want to Go Grocery Shopping Together?

213005.description:
"I want you." Imagine being told such a thing after a long and hot kiss from a beautiful elf. "I'm an introverted plain girl who's never had a boyfriend. There's nothing special about me, and the best I can do is just live a quiet life without bothering anyone else." That's what Sae Maizumi thought before she suddenly fell through the puddle she stepped on. After falling through what felt like a deep portal, she found herself in a world of elves. Where she arrived-the sacred spring of the elven forest. Sae, soaked in the water of the springs, is suddenly taken into the care of Elion, who is set to be the next leader of the forest elves. However, as a suspicious being who appeared out of nowhere, she's taken into c*ptivity! The moment Sae has a chance to break free, she makes a run for it. On her way out, she happens upon Elion's quarters to find him in an unexpected situation...?!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I'm an Introverted Maiden in Another World and Have a Handsome Elf All Over Me
title.native: 陰キャ処女な私が異世界で美形エルフに迫られてます
title.romaji: Inkya Shojo na Watashi ga Isekai de Bikei Elf ni Semararetemasu

213006.description: The story is set in a world where the Aizen Empire has conquered a world previously filled with magic and sword with the might of their guns and artillery. The story follows a group of three thieves rebelling against this established order who accidentally kidnap the princess of a fallen kingdom.
synonyms: The castle of Canaan: A Princess of a Fallen Kingdom and the World's Hidden Treasure, the Grand Scene Between the Strongest Bandits and the Hegemonic Nation

title.native: カナンの城　～亡国の王女と世界の秘宝、それを巡る最強盗賊団と覇権国家の大活劇～
title.romaji: Canaan no Shiro: Boukoku no Oujo to Sekai no Hihou, Sore wo Meguru Saikyou Touzoku-dan to Haken Kokka no Daikatsugeki

213007.description:
Born a natural-born alpha with a silver spoon in his mouth, Hui-Won had been living a carefree, debauched life that was the envy of all. Escaping his father’s gaze, who wanted him to take over the family business, he flees to a small village, where he meets a handsome young man named Yi-Ji. Contrary to Hui-Won’s expectations of seducing Yi-Ji for a steamy night, Yi-Ji brings his dog food and a leash himself, introducing himself as the “director of a dogfighting training camp”…

“I thought you were some kind of mutt, but you’re just a dog in heat, aren’t you?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213008.description:
Taken in by the Davis family, Colin shares an unshakeable connection with his adoptive brother, Jeremy. Yet as the years pass, their affection crosses into dangerous territory, bound together by reckless games and intimate provocation. Torn between familial obligation and overwhelming guilt, Colin attempts to draw the line—only for Jeremy’s possessiveness to turn increasingly intense. Desperate to break the escalating cycle, Colin enters into a sham marriage with a friend. But a heart-broken Jeremy refuses to let go, pleading for Colin to play just one final game…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

213009.description:
After being scammed by a schoolmate, Oh Min-Jae is forced into a scam himself when he is tasked with pretending to be Kwon Il-Hyeop’s first love in exchange for clearing his sudden debt. Despite Il-Hyeop’s claims, Min-Jae is certain he can’t be the rich boy’s actual first love. And yet, their first encounter has Min-Jae immediately drawn to Il-Hyeop like an animal in heat. Just what is going on? And what beastly secret could Il-Hyeop be hiding?

(Source: Tappytoon)

213010.description:
After masquerading as a chief in a ruthless crime syndicate for years, Jin-Hoo attempts to become a traitor and is caught in the act. Now he is at the mercy of the syndicate’s boss, Moo-Hyul, who harbors a twisted, possessive obsession for Jin-Hoo alone. Marked as the boss’s ultimate possession, Jin-Hoo is plunged into a dark game of relentless control and punishment… where every attempt to run only pulls the snare tighter.

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: Troy: Father’s Lover’s Son and My Boyfriend

title.native: トロイ ～父の恋人の息子、そして俺の彼氏～
title.romaji: Troy: Chichi no Koibito no Musuko, Soshite Ore no Kareshi

213012.description:
“What the hell, why is everything about you so big! it’s annoying!”

She loved volleyball, but thanks to her genetics (and her small figure), she was always stuck as a benchwarmer. Meanwhile, her tall, genius childhood friend constantly got under her skin. Out of frustration, she decided to give him a taste of his own medicine…

“The responsibility you were talking about… does it mean this?”

Unavoidably, she ended up doing it with her childhood friend?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

I Can't Help It... With My Childhood Friend

title.romaji: Osananajimi wo Shiawase ni Suru made Shinenai!!

213015.description: Having met an unfortunate end, Misaki is reincarnated as an extraordinary mandrake that transforms into a deadly monster just by screaming! Determined to finally enjoy a happy (human?) life, she manages to take on a human form, but her inability to speak causes all sorts of misunderstandings, leading people to worship her as the "Flower Witch"... While dreading being hunted if her true nature is revealed, she struggles to achieve a peaceful life!!

title.romaji: Majo no Watashi ga Anata ni Koi wo Shite mo Ii desu ka?: Anthology Comic

213019.description:
In this world, animal abilities called Anima have manifested in humans! To deal with crimes committed using Anima, the Anima Control Center has been established. Investigator Kokone, who has the ability to read people's thoughts, is on the case! But why does she keep trying to read her partner Tsubasa's mind...? From Robinson Haruhaha, creator of 'Tis Time for "Torture," Princess and Taishi Tsutsui, creator of We Never Learn comes a new comedy that's definitely on the wild side!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 極道さんはパパで愛妻家

213022.description:
Yukimaru Yoshizumi has just enrolled at Shiranami Academy, a former elite all-girls school that recently went co-ed. However, thanks to the influential "Anti-Co-ed Faction" throwing their weight around the campus, he's already on the verge of expulsion! Desperate to avoid getting kicked out, Yukimaru starts working behind the scenes. That’s when he encounters girls who harbor a striking gap between their public personas and their hidden true selves: the "Ura Girls."

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ウラあるガールに俺だけ知ってるスキがある
title.romaji: Ura Aru Girl ni Ore Dake Shitteru Suki ga Aru

213023.description:
There are two kinds of people in this world: the popular extroverts and the gloomy introverts. If you want to make the most of your limited youth, there’s only one path you should choose. In other words, if you want to be popular, become an extrovert.

Ueda Kyota, once a former introvert, reinvented himself through sheer effort and determination when he entered high school. Now, surrounded by popular kids, his school life is going smoothly. All that’s left is to get himself a gyaru girlfriend, and everything will be perfect, yet for some reason, the romantic flags keep popping up only with introverted girls…!?

title.native: 陽キャになった俺の青春至上主義
title.romaji: Youkya ni Natta Ore no Seishun Shijou Shugi

title.native: 戦利品令嬢シェリルは自分を殺す夫を籠絡したい
title.romaji: Senrihin Reijou Cheryl wa Jibun wo Korosu Otto wo Rouraku Shitai

213025.description:
There is one open secret in the influential Redhill family. Polan, the heir to Redhill, suffers from severe mysophobia and refuses to have any physical contact with women. While Gawain was worrying about his son, Etti, a mere servant, offered to help.

“I’m sure I’d be the perfect partner for the young master’s nighttime lessons...”

The opening nestled beneath his manhood was unmistakably that of a woman—

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213028.description:
Do-A Han is secretly dating Seong-U Yu, the most popular guy on campus. To the outside world, they’re just acquaintances, but behind closed doors, they’re in a relationship. However, the illusion of a perfect romance is shattered when Do-A suspects Seong-U is harboring a dark secret. Enter Eun-Ho Yeon. He’s a mysterious student who seems to know something about Seong-U. As Do-A becomes increasingly entangled with Eun-Ho, her unofficial relationship is pushed to the absolute brink. On a campus fueled by twisted desires and shifting loyalties, how far will Do-A go to uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOON)

213029.description:
For the grave sins of pride and insatiable greed, the majestic God of Winter is stripped of his divinity and cast down to the mortal realm as a cruel punishment. Stranded in a weak, fragile human body, he is desperate to reclaim his rightful place among the heavens. However, the path to restoring his godly status is paved with a singular, horrific condition: he must consume the living heart of the person he loves most.

As the fallen deity navigates the foreign emotions of mortality, he unexpectedly finds himself falling deeply in love, binding his fate to a human soul. Now, trapped in a agonizing paradox, Cheong-Hwi must choose between his eternal ambition and his newfound devotion to his lover, Gaeddong. To become a god once more, he must destroy his own salvation by plunging his love into a cold, bloody tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: เหมันต์นิรันดร์รัก

213031.description:
The cursed land of Dahalen is off-limits for a reason: no life grows there, and the abominations that roam its barren plains live only to kill. Sent into this nightmare, Priestess Yukara Koimeta succumbs to physical agony and drug-induced delirium. Just as she collapses, a massive, ancient beast looms over her broken body, threatening to devour her entirely. To survive the lethal ecosystem of Dahalen, Yukara must endure forbidden encounters with creatures far beyond human understanding. The trap is sprung, and the only way out is deeper into the beast's lair.

(Source: Lezhin US)

213033.description:
Baek Seongchan is a walking red flag. With his bleached blonde hair, rotating fleet of luxury cars, and drop-dead gorgeous looks, he lives at the center of the campus rumor mill. Everyone whispers about his wild lifestyle, but Yena couldn’t care less about the gossip. She just wants to check a very specific item off her bucket list: losing her virginity. When she asks him to sleep with her just because he's the best-looking guy around, she flips his world upside down. Seongchan is used to girls chasing him for romance, but he’s never met anyone quite as deadpan and straightforward as Yena. The game of seduction is officially on, and things are about to get anything but sober.

(Source: Lezhin US)

213034.description:
I’ve been reincarnated as Shin Kazes, the second son of a duke — a villain who uses succubus skills to corrupt the school’s heroines with pleasure, only to be defeated by the protagonist in the end.

“I don't want to just sleep with girls, I want to conquer the world.”

To become an adventurer, I decide to use my succubus skill not to seduce the heroines, but to level up my own swordsmanship…

“Big bro… please… do whatever you want with me.”
“With him, I can… be my true self.”

Aina Kazes, the Ice Lady, and Clarice Flott, the noble Countess. Before I knew it, these cool and dignified ladies are starting to reveal their sexual desires to me…!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: エロゲのヒロインを淫魔スキルで支配する
title.romaji: Eroge no Heroine wo Inma Skill de Shihai Suru

213035.description:
Paradise: a complete world free of anger, suffering, and sorrow. In this place, where angels maintain absolute order and peace, Sai meets Shiera, a failure of an angel. As the two slowly grow closer, their encounter begins to expose the hidden corruption lurking beneath Paradise...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

213036.description:
Song Jae-Young, a typical high school student, is perplexed when Kang Yi-Han, a mysterious classmate, suddenly breaks down in tears at the sight of him. Following this encounter, Jae-Young's life takes an unexpected turn as Yi-Han begins sticking close by, offering his help with an unusual sense of familiarity. As strange events begin to unfold around him, Jae-Young grapples with the growing question: Can he truly trust this enigmatic boy who seems to know him so well?

(Source: Lezhin US)

213037.description:
Ten years after arriving at a fantasy world, Taeseong loses everything to the betrayal of a fellow human. Reincarnated as a goblin named Gorulz, he is given a chance to seek revenge. Leveling up, gaining the trust and adoration of other goblins, becoming the leader of his own clan, they all serve a single goal: to slaughter the humans he has come to despise.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ชีวิตใหม่ในร่างก็อบลิน

213039.description:
He Zhuo was once a ruthless billionaire Alpha, but losing his Omega husband, Ji Tingyu, broke him completely. Ji Tingyu had despised their forced marriage, even pulling a gun on He Zhuo on their wedding night. Only after Ji Tingyu’s tragic death did He Zhuo realize the depth of his own regret. Now reborn into the past, the dominant Wolf King changes his tactics completely. Swearing an unbreakable oath of absolute devotion, he will aggressively pamper his prickly husband while destroying the hidden enemies who once forced them apart.

(Source: Tappytoon)

213041.description:
Living takes money, and desperation leads to bad decisions. On a pitch-black night, a risky break-in to steal fast cash turns disastrous. Unconsciousness comes with a single blow. Waking up tied down in a cold, unfamiliar warehouse, escape is impossible. Desperate resistance from Gaku yields nothing against Masumi, the dangerous homeowner who commands the room. Instead of calling the cops, he offers a twisted deal: atone for the crime by becoming his dog. Trapped in captivity, a perilous bond of madness and obsession begins.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: A Dog That Pays the Price

213043.description:
When Hae-Seo sees Tae-Gon, the boy he once saved, return to the sea where he lives as an adult, he feels both joy and a deep attraction toward him. Though they reunite in human form, he accidentally reveals his true identity as a mermaid to Tae-Gon, and he begins to show increasingly violent and obsessive behavior toward him...

“The love between a mermaid and a human will turn to bubbles if it isn't true love.”

Having begun to doubt Tae-Gon’s affection, Hae-Seo realizes he has been cursed.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213044.description:
“Jjukku Jjukku” (Hyeon-U), an alien drifting through space, crashes-lands on Earth after running out of fuel. But to collect fuel, he absolutely must have sex with a human...

“Can't you have sex with someone else instead of me?”

“No, human!!”

Ki-Beom, who accidentally picks up the alien Jjukku Jjukku (Hyeon-U) as he’s rambling about sex, will their first sexual encounter go smoothly?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213049.description: Kiyotaki, who’s looking for a lover, decides to meet someone through a dating app that is rumored to let you meet non-humans! The person who shows up to their first date is a very tall, long-tongued, and incredibly charismatic non-human — Morebito! Fascinated by non-humans, Kiyotaki becomes closer with Morebito as their relationship gets more intimate…

title.native: 人外と人外とお付き合いしたい人間の話
title.romaji: Jingai to Jingai to Otsukiai Shitai Ningen no Hanashi

213050.description:
Arad, once trapped in a ruthless company in his past life, is reborn as a noble in another world and lives the easy, carefree life he always wanted. But he has one frustration: every year, the once-in-a-lifetime “Divine Lottery” fails him, leaving him unable to use magic. Everything changes when he begins to see mysterious mana fragments left behind by spells. What’s more, by collecting them, he can learn those spells himself. What begins as a secret ability soon sets Arad on the path to becoming an unparalleled noble and legendary archmage.

(Source: WEBTOON)

213059.description:
"How much money could a woman’s face be worth?"

She was once queen. But when her face becomes partially disfigured in an accident, an imperial decree demotes Dongfang Ningxing to concubine. Not only that, but her younger sister takes her place as the new queen, while Dongfang Ningxing gets married off to the cold and brutal Prince Xueqin. And this second marriage is not a happy one, ending only in her death. Lucky for Dongfang Ningxing, her spirit is unwilling to fade away... it’s not her time yet! She still has work to do! So, Dongfang Ningxing gets a second chance. And this time, Dongfang Ningxing is ready. She must hone amazing talents, be the most beautiful in all the land, and must outmatch even the heavens! Will she succeed??

(Source: Comikey)

葬霊のラメント ～乙女は彷徨える魂に餞を～

213065.description:
For her lover of 10 years, belle of the ball Julia Rapiere played the part of a sheltered flower in a greenhouse. That is, until he betrayed her by having an affair with her trusted maid. Bent on revenge, Julia reveals her true colors, and the demure flower transforms into a fearsome monster.

(Source: Manta)

213070.description:
Hikari, a young boy who lost his mother in a fire, begins living with Yojin, the investigator assigned to the case. Their peaceful life is often interrupted by the appearance of otherworldly creatures. A stylish action adventure that takes place in between the mundane and the mysterious now begins!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

213071.description:
Da-Won is your average college freshman-- except that she can see ghosts. All she wants is a normal life, and maybe a little spice of love. But when she runs into the all-too-handsome Da-Ham, president of the occult club, her life turns upside down. From fortune-telling to investigating urban legends, Da-Won can't shake the feeling that there's more to Da-Ham than he's letting on. Is this destiny or something far more sinister?

(Source: WEBTOON)

213073.description:
Olympic marksman Seung-A becomes an assassin to avenge her sister's murder, all while balancing her dark destiny between two captivating women. Inside her vigilante squad, she fights a growing passion for her intense team leader, Si-Hyeon. At her cover job as a bookstore employee, she yields to the seductive charms of Yu-Rim, a stunning regular customer. As both relationships deepen, a devastating secret looms over their heads. The alluring Yu-Rim is secretly the cold female mastermind behind a dangerous plot, forcing Seung-a into a deadly choice between her partner and her enemy.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: サソリの刻～復讐の毒牙～

213075.description:
Seo-Ha has spent two years working as a secretary for the cold Do-Hyeon, the director of a conglomerate, while harboring a secret, unrequited love for him. But when a canceled flight strands them together for one unexpected night, everything changes. What begins as a secret fling quickly spirals into something far more complicated when Do-Hyeon’s powerful family starts arranging his marriage to another woman, and Seo-Ha discovers that she is pregnant. Will Seo-Ha be able to win Do-Hyeon’s heart, or will she lose him to another woman forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

213076.description:
Notes:
- Original serialization ran for 13 chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 9 and 10 were combined as Chapter 9 and the succeeding chapters were renumbered accordingly.
- Includes three extra chapters.

213077.description:
Returning after 26 years following a certain mission, Mia finds a drastically altered Earth, divided into scorching heat and freezing cold, a place where humans cannot survive...Mia and her AI robot, Shirowan, land in the only twilight zone where humans can survive, and encounter a terrifying creature on Earth—!? What has become of the Earth, of humanity!? On a drastically changed Earth, one person and one animal continue their journey—!!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

213078.description:
"Save the world with my 'love'!"

Raira, the daughter of a witch, has lived in the shadow of her great mother, acting the part of a “pure and innocent beautiful girl.” But, fueled by a momentary spark of lewd curiosity, she accidentally opens the gate connecting the human world and the demon world...!! And the key to saving the world she has betrayed turns out to be the “impure true feelings” she has kept hidden――!?

213079.description:
This is... unbelievably sexy to watch... He shouldn't say stuff like that with his crotch all hard and throbbing, or she'll be dripping wet in no time!

Kaoru Mizuki was recently dumped because of her inverted nipples, which she's insecure about. Meanwhile, her rival in work, Soichiro Ichinose, is such a specimen that there's no way he'd ever have issues in the bedroom. The rumors say he's the best and completely relentless... but then he reveals that he's impotent! Kaoru and Soichiro are like oil and water, but for some reason, she's the only one who excites him... This has to be some kind of joke. Still, Kaoru agrees to help him out, which is how she finds herself in his powerful arms, unable to move... If he goes any further, though, he'll remove her bra and reveal the secret of her inverted nipples...!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: My Impotent Coworker Licks My Inverted Nipples, Makes Them Stiff, and Fondles Them.

title.romaji: ED Douki wa Kanbotsu Chikubi wo Namete, Tatasete, Kawaigaru.

213080.description:
“Humans remain nothing but a blight upon us demons.”

A boy who was once bullied in his past life is reincarnated into another world as Demon King Noct, seeking to rule over everything. However, just before achieving his ambition, he is sealed away through a cunning scheme along with his loyal generals. Three thousand years pass, and Noct finally succeeds in breaking free from his seal. Before him lies a world where grotesque monsters prey on humans, and those very humans oppress the demon race. Upon learning of the world’s devastation, Noct sets his plans into motion, gathering his former allies from the Demon King’s army to reclaim dominance. His first order of business: rescuing demons who are about to be sacrificed to monsters and exacting vengeance upon humanity.

“Kneel before me, world. My kin, commence the march!”

Thus begins the ultimate Demon King’s conquest for world domination!
synonyms: The Demon Lord who Returned after 3000 Years: The Strongest Reincarnator Aims for World Domination

Soon after enrolling, she meets Kaoru, a trendy girl; Yoshi & Dai-chan, a gay couple; and Yamazaki, a professional photographer who also works as an instructor. With a casual "Why don't you live together over there?", the five begin living together.

Hopes and anxieties about the future, the uncertainties of unsuccessful romances, unhealed wounds from the past... This is a bittersweet love and life story about five people living "five minutes before their youth ends," a story that will leave you breathless.

Stamping paw prints on the author’s manuscript, relieving itself anywhere it pleases, eating whatever food is put down, causing trouble and then feigning innocence—through the author’s distinctive powers of observation, the cat’s traits are described in a comical way. Anyone who has ever kept a cat will be able to relate.

213202.description:
When a dungeon rescue goes wrong, Yul is forced to fight a monster far stronger than himself. He struggles desperately to survive, and awakens a hidden power driven by memories of the hero who once saved him--the ability to design a labyrinth and turn it into a weapon against monsters. Yet monsters aren’t the only threat. Corruption runs deep in this society ruled by powerful and greedy hunters, and Yul must overcome a series of unexpected challenges to become the hero he set out to be.

(Source: WEBTOON)

213203.description:
In this life, I will rule the battlefield. Damian, a captain in the Baroque Kingdom’s Punishment Corps.

“Damn it Just once. If only I were given one more chance… I really would have ruled the battlefield alongside these guys.'

At the age of 30, I closed my eyes on an anonymous battlefield. But when I opened my eyes, I had returned to 17 years ago. And not just that, I possessed a fully functional magic vein that allowed me to cultivate magic.

‘This time. I will rise higher than anyone else. I won’t be swept along by the era of war. I will be the one to rule.’

Damian, having returned to the past, swings his spear at the world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

213204.description:
For three years, while studying abroad, Vivian shared intimate nights with a mysterious man who existed only in her dreams. Upon returning home, she discovers he is real, and none other than Rozher Orpheus, the Emperor's Mad Hound. But now the Emperor is saying he wants them to get engaged?!

213207.description:
Roxanna spent years grieving her first love who supposedly died at the hands of her father, a greedy and cruel nobleman. However, when her household is annihilated, she discovers that the man who led the downfall of her family is her first love, Curtis. No longer the gentle boy Roxanna once cherished, he has transformed into a cold, formidable warrior driven by a calculated thirst for retribution. Since then, Roxanna is content to live humbly and quietly in a nunnery. However, as circumstances bring her and Curtis to reunite, the desire for vengeance rears its ugly head once again.

(Source: Tappytoon)

213220.description: At work she's perfect: cool, assertive, and flawless! Miiko, the head of accounting, is a role model to everyone. But as soon as she gets home, everything changes - she transforms into a super clingy and loving wife! And instead of becoming more calm after getting married, her expressions of love just keep getting more and more excessive!? The romantic comedy story of a husband and wife who love each other with all their heart, 365 days a year, is about to begin!

213222.description:
Takumi Sumino is a totally average teenager living in the Tokyo Residential Complex, a place where every day is much like the last and nothing bad ever happens. All that changes when freakish monsters attack the town and start wreaking havoc. A strange creature calling himself Sirei appears and offers Takumi the power to protect those he holds dear... All he has to do is stab himself in the chest!

The next thing he knows, Takumi is in Last Defense Academy, a school in the middle of nowhere surrounded by a wall of otherworldly flames. He and 14 other students have been drafted into the Special Defense Unit, a team tasked with keeping the school safe for the next 100 days. How much are they willing to sacrifice to take back their normal lives and save the world from the grotesque school invaders?

The curtain rises on 100 days of war and despair...

(Source: Steam)

213224.description:
Bound by bloodlines and a dangerous secret, Do-Yul - heir to the powerful Kumiho clan - forced Jae-Hyeon, the second son of the Wolf clan, to swallow his pearl to keep him close forever. Now, Do-Yul relies entirely on Jae-Hyeon for his essence, while Jae-Hyeon conceals a longing crush, enduring the pain of staying by his side. As tensions rise between their rivaling shapeshifter families, Jae-Hyeon uncovers a dark plot at the Kumiho research lab before Do-Yul takes an official mate...

Speed and winning is all that matters in this world. After years of struggling in the competitive world of motor sports, Miharu Suzukaze is ready to give up on his dreams of being a champion racer. 213231.description:
Even though she was my older sister, she was younger than me. In a remote mountain village, my sister disappeared, leaving behind a mysterious message. Left to fend for myself, I, her younger brother, come to uncover the village’s hidden secrets. What on earth happened to my sister…? Nostalgia, cruelty, and lyricism. Having been gifted a premium pass to Bianca Aquarium, Suze and her best friend, Lulu, receive a guided tour led by the aquarium director’s charming wife, Chrissy. However, when Lulu suddenly goes missing, Suze goes looking for her and inexplicably finds herself in a strange and terrifying world that looks nothing like the aquarium she was at just moments ago. Can Suze find her best friend and escape from the nightmarish aquarium before it’s too late? Beware, for a traitor lurks in their midst...

(Source: Nintendo eShop)

213234.description:
Ko I-Deum is a total shut in who knows how to do one thing, and one thing only: write passionate BL smut. There’s just one small problem: I-Deum is a complete and total virgin. To try and stimulate his brain (among other things), I-Deum takes to…well, “taking care of himself” in front of the window, imagining all sorts of sensual scenarios to jumpstart his creative juices. Sure, there may be an apartment right across from him, but nobody’s lived there for years…until now! Mid self-love session, he looks up to see a man staring at him from across the street - and not just any man, but the bisexual icon and surely soon-to-be celeb, acting major Kwon Jae-Yi. Some might say their situation is a little too close for comfort…but maybe it’s just the right distance for something more.

Drunkenly nursing a broken heart with his ears and tail on full display, he expects pity, not passion. But Director Sa Hyeon sees a rare opportunity right in front of him. Striking up a conversation with the vulnerable tiger, Hyeon effortlessly reels him in. One steamy night leads to an unexpected emotional connection, but staying professional at work becomes impossible when body chemistry takes over.

Sangla Heeyo, Princess of Heaven and the Netherworld, is a powerful immortal trapped in a frail form. One day, she meets the spirit of Princess Ruhwa and learns of her tragic past. In exchange for granting Ruhwa a new life among the immortals, Heeyo assumes her body and takes her place in the human realm. With her health restored and divine power intact, Heeyo embraces the ordinary joys she once dreamed of while uncovering the truth behind Ruhwa’s death and delivering divine punishment.

213249.description: Five high schoolers have formed a club to study the supernatural. Its members include leader Hikaru Shibayama, who exhibits minor powers of telekinesis; and Kiyoshi Kitagawa, who can see human spirits. The kids are excited to hear that Shibayama has been invited to appear on TV to demonstrate his abilities. At their school, a new transfer student named Ryou Tsukano arrives. Tsukano claims that his favorite hobby is going for long walks because he always finds something exciting and special.

213250.description:
The owner, a former scout for a once-promising baseball team, meets Ki-Jeong, a high school student who dreams of becoming a professional baseball player. While everyone else talks about Ki-Jeong’s limitations, the owner is the only one who immediately recognizes his genius and offers sincere advice to keep him from giving up on baseball. To Ki-Jeong, the owner was the only person in his entire life who believed in him just as he was.

“Ki-Jeong, your hands and feet are bigger than mine. That means you could end up taller than me, too.”

But the happiness was short-lived; without a word, the owner resigned from his scouting position and vanished completely. Five years later the owner returns to his former team with a new title as a performance analysis manager, where he is reunited with Ki-Jeong, now a professional baseball player who has grown beyond recognition. Though taken aback by Ki-Jeong’s changed appearance, the owner finds himself unable to look away...

“The number I never got back then... can I get it now?”

The time that had stood still for the two of them, frozen in longing, begins to move again on the scorching mound.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

After so many years spent side by side, one important question remains unanswered: will life be bearable when the day inevitably comes that they are separated? 213270.description:
Cheong-Yeon asks Do-Heon for a divorce, putting an end to their three-year marriage.

“I feel like I’ve seen everything there is to see by now, so let’s just end it here. Please grant me a divorce, Mr. Do-Heon.”

And so, Yu Cheong-Yeon, a high school graduate from a working-class background, now finds himself labeled a divorcee. He struggles to restart her acting career, which he had given up due to Do-Heon’s opposition, but his ex-husband seems to be acting strangely.

“A sugar… daddy?”

Eventually, Do-Heon even offers Cheong-Yeon a sugar daddy arrangement.

“Once a week. You’ll meet me every Friday night.”
“Why should I accept a sugar daddy arrangement from you, Mr. Do-Heon?”
“Because I can get you a role in that drama. As the lead, of course.”
“Fine. As long as there’s no physical contact. It’s not like you’re making this offer just because you want to sleep with me anyway.”
“Why do you think I wouldn’t ask you for sex?”
“Of course sex is included. Isn’t that a basic condition of a sugar arrangement?”

"Don't get too close to others, and don't get into other people's business."

That's Misaki's motto. She used to always go out of her way to help others but after getting tangled up in other people's problems, she's had enough! Misaki has learned to smell trouble from a mile away. Anyone with an overwhelming charm is bound to be a huge headache. The new hire is just her type, but he exudes and aura of... trouble? Misaki wants to keep her distance from him, but she's ordered to look after him...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

213285.description:
“So, I’m going to die again… isn’t that right?”

Every time, she is accused of a crime she didn’t commit, stripped of her engagement, imprisoned, and ultimately poisoned to death in her cell. This has already happened five times. After all those cycles of life and death repeating the same way, she no longer has the energy to fight back. She no longer cares about her fate… But this time, before her usual end arrives, the strongest sorcerer on the continent suddenly appears to break this endless loop! However, his rescue doesn’t come without a price. When she asks him why he interfered, he smiles confidently and says: “I only want one thing in return… the right to flirt with you.”

From endless convictions to an unexpected romance—will this new life be any different from the ones before? Or does fate still have surprises in store for her?

A romantic tale filled with mystery, magic, and a destiny that refuses to leave the heroine in peace!

Given a chance to redo her sad, short life, neglected noble daughter Panora Celsius swears to live only for revenge against all who wronged her. As she watches her enemies weep, her conscience grows, and the future she knew begins to shift like sand beneath her feet. Will she be able to outsmart her enemies, old and new, until the end?

To think an older man could be this sexy...! Tsubasa lost the job offer that was just on the table after the whole company folded in. Wallowing over a drink, he somehow manages to start chatting with the handsome older man next to him, Kazuomi, and finds his way into his bed. He seemed so adorable and passionate in bed, but come morning Kazuomi's taken on a new attitude and blaming it all on the alcohol...?

Who would've thought an idol's love could be this heavy?! Mao Fukiyama is fresh out of a scandal, and currently not allowed to do much while his agency is getting things under control. The timing couldn't have been more perfect, as Taiga Endo, another talent from the same agency working as one of the top boy band idols, invites Mao to live in his apartment while things blow over. Meanwhile, Prince Kaian, who suffers terrible agony every new moon night due to a curse passed down through the royal family, lives with the sole goal of eliminating every witch in the world. One day, three brazen cats (witches) appear before Isaac and propose a deal, asking him to fetch a tinder box. As a result, Isaac finds himself unexpectedly entangled with Kaian. Although he is constantly gripped by a sense of danger, as if his head might be severed from his neck at any moment, Isaac, a clumsy and carefree young man who is willing to do anything for the prince, the most handsome man in the kingdom, wonders if he will truly be able to find his own happiness and fulfill the prince’s wish…?

213479.description:
I can say with certainty that the ugliest emotion of all is inferiority.

My grandmother had wanted a daughter her whole life, but she never had a daughter or a granddaughter. Her grandson, Ho Su-Won, who is now the director of a ballet academy, has made a living off his grandmother’s name. The family members who gather at the funeral home to divide her estate are confronted with the true legacy she left behind. The final daughter created by a woman who vowed never to leave behind a sense of inferiority. The sense of inferiority has not ended. It has merely changed form and begun anew.

(Source: Naver, translated)

213480.description:
"I'm sorry... I got jealous. It was immature of me."
The sugar-sweet epilogue to the popular age-gap BL series is finally here!

Rihito and Maki go to a hot spring resort for some quality time together. Despite worrying what others might think, they get caught up in the atmosphere and can't help but flirt openly. However, the moment Maki lets Rihito out of his sight, he gets hit on, and Maki is unable to hold back his jealousy. Rihito gets excited by Maki's unexpected possessive streak and fans his desires further, whispering, "I want to see more of that side of you..."

213490.description:
On the planet Thebe, she was hailed as the “Lord of Death” and the “Living Dead”, the most powerful necromancer of all. With Serezia’s help, she managed to return on her own, but as a side effect, she lost all her power and took on the form of a frail young girl, even developing a fear of people. While in this state, she watches a live stream by a novice necromancer named Song Ha-Yeon and, in exchange for giving her advice, receives a magic stone imbued with fraud. She discovers that if she obtains fraud from other sources, she can use necromancy. Before long, she becomes entangled with Helena, an S-rank hunter and necromancer, and learns that her power hasn’t disappeared but is sealed by some unknown force, and upon seeing a status window appear, she realizes that if he levels up as a hunter, she can regain his power, so she resolves to become a hunter.

“The ruler of the Underworld, who overcame even death, has finally returned to Earth. Though, due to the side effects of dimensional travel, he’s now a total loser.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

213491.description:
I’ve returned to that dreadful early spring. The season when I had my blood drawn under the pretense of a ritual for the Countess, and endured appalling treatment without even knowing my mother was dead. In my past life, it was the cursed Grand Duke, Kalian Orpheus, who saved me from hell. Our contract marriage began with a promise: if he would rescue me from the Count’s mansion, I would purify him from his madness. Though it started purely as a contract, I found myself helplessly falling for him. I was happy. Though my end was tragic, due to the Countess’s curse. To uncover the truth behind my death and my mother’s, I must escape the Count’s mansion once more. As a powerless bastard child, I have no choice but to use you again.

“Just one more time… may I rely on you?”

Falling in love with you wasn’t part of the plan. At least not in this life.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: I Became the Wife of the Cursed Grand Duke

213492.description:
Claire, the eldest daughter of a poor marquis family, is proposed to by the young Duke Hilaire, the country's most nobleman, to enter into a contract marriage for a limited period of one year for a certain reason. Surprised by the sudden proposal, Claire accepts the contract marriage and becomes a duchess, but is bullied by the servants soon after her marriage. However, having been mistreated by her family for many years, Claire does not give up no matter what happens, solving numerous problems and gaining allies. At first, Hilaire thought Claire was an odd woman, but before he knows it, he finds himself watching her closely. A frustratingly sweet love story that begins with a false marriage.

(Source: SHERPA STUDIO, translated)

213493.description:
A notorious pirate with a bounty on her head. The world called her the “Judge of Salvation.” But what Daphne wants is neither justice nor salvation. It is nothing but revenge against the kingdom that destroyed her mother and her family and took everything from her. However, her voyage of revenge takes an unexpected turn. A man she spent a single night with after a chance encounter. She had no idea he would turn out to be the most relentless naval officer from the very kingdom that was hunting her down. A revolution shaking the kingdom to its core, hidden conspiracies, and one man who keeps throwing a wrench in her plans. Caught in the whirlwind of revenge and revolution, will Daphne finally reach the end she desires?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

213499.description:
Gerald Dern, the eldest son of the Dern family, joins the Civil War determined not to disappoint his father. However, the war takes everything from him—his entire family is killed, and the shock of witnessing even his fellow soldiers massacred leaves him without the will to live. When it finally ends, the family fortune is gone as well, leaving him with nothing but a ranch in a distant wasteland. Once a war hero and the flawless heir to the Dern name, Gerald retreats there, intending to put an end to his life. But his plans are completely upended when he meets Ezra, a cowboy of mixed Native heritage.

"Me? I'm your humble slave, Master."

Claiming to be Gerald's slave, Ezra constantly crosses boundaries and provokes him at every turn. Yet in the face of Ezra's relentless attention, Gerald's heart begins to race once more.

"This is all his fault for getting me so worked up."

One man has lost everything and wishes to end his life. The other is determined to keep him alive—and by his side. Thus begins a precarious romance on the wasteland.

(Source: Manta)

213500.description:
Su-Ha, who once dreamed of becoming a race car driver, was forced to give up his dreams after suffering an accident caused by a sudden onset of hypersensitivity. On an ordinary day, just like any other, he helps a man named Chris, who is unlike anyone he’s ever met, and his whole life is turned upside down...

“Thanks for your help, but… are you… getting an erection right now?”

213501.description:
Forgive me, okay...? I can't stop myself.

Kasumi, a beta, works as a manager at a talent agency. All the boyfriends that she's dated have all gotten involved with omegas. Kasumi's only solace as an ordinary beta background character is popular influencer K. K is a feminine alpha that's unaffiliated with an agency, and no one knows what he looks like beneath his mask. One day on the way home from work, Kasumi runs into K who she's admired so much!! It's a perfect chance to scout him... But all of a sudden, Kasumi's body starts heating up...? With just a touch, an overwhelming pleasure pierces through her entire body. "So that's how much you want me, huh?" Even though she's supposed to be a beta, she's gone into heat!? What's K's true identity? Confounded with her omega gender that's intertwined with instinct, romance, and destiny, Kasumi looks to the future and learns to love.

Yu is your average pushover of a construction site supervisor who hardly has any interest in dating. After his contractor company takes on a new client who is opening a cafe, Yu is paired up with up-and-coming interior designer Seiji Takenaka. Seiji is an attractive and flashy man that Yu's construction crew feels intimidated by. In their first encounter, Seiji introduces himself to Yu by... kissing him on the cheek! Do men usually greet each other that way!? Yu's thrown off of his game and can hardly focus on his work.

One day, Seiji expresses his concern for Yu since he hardly has time to eat a real meal and invites him out to dinner. Overwhelmed by the fancy restaurant Seiji takes him to, Yu lets his guard down and throws back his fruity cocktail. Brought together as stepbrothers by their parents' remarriage, Wujae and Yuhyeon grew up leaning on each other in a cold, lonely home. That deep bond crossed the line after an unexpected first kiss, sparking a secret romance they couldn't share with anyone. But a sudden, bitter breakup tore them apart, leaving Wujae consumed by resentment and Yuhyeon aching with longing. Ten years later, fate forces them back into each other's lives in the most unexpected place.

Anna was dumped by his ex-boyfriend because he didn’t express his love well enough. On the night of the breakup, he gets drunk and satisfies his desires alone. Meanwhile, Kkikki, the monkey doll who had been guarding Anna’s bedroom, fulfills his wish to become human and try all sorts of naughty things, and turns into a human. Anna, who enjoyed his first encounter with Kkikki, pretends to give in and begins living with him. Kkikki seems to obey Anna at first, but soon begins demanding more extreme acts, as if to stimulate his hidden desires.

Meanwhile, Kkikki must hear a “confession of true love” in order to live as a human forever. Unaware of this fact, Anna gradually begins to develop feelings for Kkikki as a lover— beyond just a sexual relationship…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

One day, my older brother came home with a young coworker, and I'd never seen someone so innocently, earnestly, uselessly in love as this guy was. What does he mean, just looking is enough for him? Getting off is obviously the better option here. His attitude was a novelty to me, as a notorious slut (and card-carrying bottom to boot). So at first it was out of curiosity, plain and simple, that I laid hands on him without a second thought (figured I'd let him show me the sexual side he can't show to the one he so virtuously loves). That was the idea, at least...

213565.description:
"I've missed you, Shota…" "Tohru... Me, too...!"

I still can't get used to it no matter how many times we do it, so sometimes it hurts a little... But it feels so good... When Shota returns to Tokyo after visiting home, he and Tohru enjoy a long-awaited reunion. He brings back happy news - he's come out to his family and told them that he's dating a man - and the pair's love starts heating up from there! But in the midst of that happiness, Shota starts to worry that he isn't the right match for this handsome older man and is only a burden on Tohru, and misunderstandings begin to grow between the two of them...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

213566.description:
After splitting up with his friend with benefits, he's just been building up stress with no outlet, and so police officer Ritsu spends every day working at the neighborhood police station bursting with irritation. When a chance encounter brings him to Naoya - a man who's got Ritsu's ideal "package" - his irritated mood does a complete one-eighty. His skin is glowing, his spirits are high, and everything's coming up roses... or so he thought?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: In Over My Head With A 23-Year-Old

213567.description:
The long-awaited spin-off of the hit series High School boy and Yakuza is here!

"Why is my life so crappy?"

Yui laments his life despite being a candidate to take over the Todo Family, one of the largest Yakuza families in the Osaka area. He was separated from his older brother, Kazumi, when they were children, he has never stopped waiting for him. When he finally finds him, he's become the young head of the rival Joshima family in Tokyo. However, Yui finds that instead of him, Kazumi has another by his side... Jealous of his brother's boyfriend, Yui attacks him, angering Kazumi and forcing him to place him under the watch of his underling, Ryo. At first, Yui is wary of him, but Ryo slowly fills the hole in Yui's heart with his kindness and...?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

213568.description:
College student Ichiki can't help but beguile everyone around him with his dazzling smile. But the one person he's head over heels for is... his ultra ordinary manager Mr. Yomura! Homely but hardworking Mr. Yomura stole Ichiki's heart, and after a tireless pursuit Ichiki managed at long last to get his hands on boyfriend status. Now, three months since they started dating... they still haven't made any progress in their relationship?! Even with all the romance tactics popular-guy Ichiki has at his disposal, Mr. Yomura is a formidable conquest...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

213569.description:
A world where demons coexist with humans. While there have been no conflicts in the past between demons and humans, demons possess tremendous abilities, can use a variety of magic, and have the power to control humans as underlings. Demons are at the top of the biological hierarchy, so to speak. So now I, Toma, am the underling to the demon, Chiaki. Every night I have to feed him my bodily fluids to "replenish his magical powers". He licks me all over... Our lewd acts should have no meaning; our relationship is a master-servant one. But why does my heart ache so much...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

213570.description:
Naoki (36) is a workaholic who's never been in a relationship. Then he meets his first boyfriend, the cheerful and animated Minato (21). Desperate for Minato's affection, Naoki does everything he can to maintain that mature, confident and perfect boyfriend. For some reason, though, he keeps on rejecting Minato's invitations to have a bit of good ol' intimate fun. Could Naoki be hiding something from Minato...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

213571.description:
Rintarou Itoshiki, an ordinary high school boy, was supposed to be tending to the famous sword "Muramura" passed down through his family, but before he knows it, he has been transported to another world. Furthermore, the true identity of Muramura is that of a cursed sword that forces the user to ejaculate as many times as the number of enemies defeated...!? To return to his original world and to suppress his overflowing hypersexuality, Rintarou decides to form a harem party and conquer dungeons.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

213572.description:
Kei is totally, utterly, completely in love with Tsurugi! But he's also tormented with uncertainty. Is it just him that feels this way? Is it safe to call them boyfriends? Even while agonizing over questions like these, Kei always plays it cool around his beloved Tsurugi. When they have sex, though, Tsurugi's adorable charms reduce Kei to a helpless puddle of a man, and today is no exception - he might as well be a devoted puppy wagging his tail at full force.

Love is flooding through everything in this mature BL that's just as fluffy and sweet as it is smutty!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

213573.description:
Takakura and Yatsuka, who attend the same university, are such close friends that they live together. However, when Takakura told him "I have feelings for you," Yatsuka started rushing things forward without stopping to think it over?! I like you... But now's not the time!!

It's a love affair that twists itself into knots while these two guys impatiently race around and around only to get nowhere.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

213574.description:
Every inch of my body within the sworn enemy's tender grasp... How did this happen?!
Gangly hero meets monstrous yet charmingly sweet demon in this guiltily sweet romance.

I'm Masakiyo Kato (21), also known as Skull Black. I may be somewhat scrawny, but I'm a protector of justice. Today, once again, I'm defending the town against Baphomet, a commander from an evil organization. At least that was the plan! He somehow ends up pinning me against the wall... again. As if that weren't enough, he shows up at my place asking, "What do you want first? A bath? Dinner? Or do you want me?" What the hell does this giant beast want? And why is he trying to get me to marry him?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A salaryman overwhelmed by his work ends up in an unspeakable relationship with his subordinate?!

Kurobashi is who the company goes to for all the issues the company is having. His only reprieve is his mobile phone social dating game. Having ascended to the ranks of chief, the overwhelming nature of his job leads him to spend all of his income on the game he's addicted to. To make some extra change, Kurobashi starts a secret side hustle: work as a male ear cleaning "maid." His first client ever turns out to be his real-life subordinate, Yashirogi?! Plus, things escalate from ear cleaning to another type of "hand" service...?! So begins this BL salaryman rom-com.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Five years ago, while keeping his face hidden, he spent one unforgettable day and night with another man. When a total coincidence brings them back together, the long-banked fires of his passion reignite and he finds himself once again desperately yearning for the other man.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

213578.description:
Miu is a preschool teacher who's strapped for cash. Recently, he started working nights at Club Hatch, where men find comfort through baby roleplay. One night, Miu gets assigned to Hiroshi Yuuki, a first-timer who seems unsociable and disinterested. But when Miu switches to "mommy" mode, little Hiro finds himself oddly aroused by Miu's nipples, and asks his Mommy to breastfeed him for his mealtime! Tonight, our mommy's about to learn that sometimes, to satisfy your baby, you have to get a little naughty!

Monsters known as Calamities have invaded Earth, and humanity fights back using powerful abilities. But everything changes when a near-death experience awakens Mugen, the most powerful Calamity in history, within him. Thanks to this, Kouya gains a powerful skill, but Mugen remains inside him, waiting for a chance to steal his body for himself. Can Kouya become the savior he’s always dreamed of, or will Mugen succeed in bringing about humanity’s destruction?

The hero who saved the world and the King of all the Relics, the Majesty Jooheon Suh. He lives a “peaceful” life exploring and raiding tombs for the sake of his future daughter until he is prompted by the Rule Book to take part in the Majesty War. Initially dismissive, Jooheon intends to ignore the Rule Book’s odd demand until his daughter’s existence is removed from this world. With the knowledge that god-rank relics are behind his daughter’s disappearance, Jooheon takes a stance against the relics and fights against the anomalies brought about by his strange encounter with the Rule Book. Even if he must face literal gods, Jooheon will stop at nothing to bring back what was his.

(Source: WEBTOON)

213618.description:
Join Kirby and his Dream Land friends as they go on zany adventures in manga form!

Dream Land’s innocent troublemaker Kirby is back at it again with more of the mischief fans of all ages know and love. These cute and carefree Kirby comics—ready to be consumed in any order or inhaled all at once—will leave fans tickled pink!
(Source: Viz Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

213619.description:
Kirby dances onto the stage once again in this collection of classic—and new—comics for all ages! When everyone’s favorite pink puff finds out he’s become a video game superstar, he gets greedy for more, causing King Dedede and the rest of Dream Land to hammer some sense into him!

(Source: Viz Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

213620.description:
Kirby and his Dream Land friends are back with more tales—old and new—for fans of all ages! Adeleine paints herself a boyfriend. Meta Knight loses his mask. And Gordo finds his spiky invincibility has a major drawback. But don’t worry! The pink star of the show and his manic antics are there through it all!
(Source: Viz Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

213621.description:
Kirby and crew are up to their old shenanigans again in these classic—and new—comics for all ages! From a Dream Land summer heat wave to Kirby’s endless questions and sudden desire to grow up, King Dedede has his hands full. But can the situation really be so bad that he wants Kirby to take over his kingly duties?!

(Source: Viz Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

213622.description:
Whet your appetite for more wacky adventures with Kirby and friends! What in Dream Land could cause Kirby to refuse all food? Will he get his appetite back when Adeleine makes rice balls to share? And there’s no telling what’ll happen with King Dedede and Poppy in their own zany capers!

(Source: Viz Media)

213623.description:
Kirby and friends cook up more fun in another batch of cute comics! King Dedede discovers a passion for fashion. Kirby lands a job at Waddle Dee Cafe. And an April Fools’ Day face-off goes too far! All this and more is on the menu in volume seven!

(Source: Viz Media)

213624.description:
Kirby and his pals are back for more fun and games in Dream Land! But life isn’t always easy for the cute pink puff. This time, Kirby trains for an entire year…to split disposable chopsticks clean in two! Then, he braves a battlefield full of dangers…the grocery store! After all that, he makes a tough choice…between flavors of shaved ice! Hang in there, Kirby!

(Source: Viz Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

Kirby’s frantic, fun-filled adventures continue! Whether he’s hitting home runs in a baseball game, acting on TV, or writing a best-selling novel, the manic mascot’s determined to get his 15 minutes of fame. Plus, Kirby’s taken up a new hobby…air riding! But when he takes lessons to get his rider’s license, can he win a race against his own instructor?!

(Source: Viz Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

When Tae-Ung’s shaman father vanishes, an ancient calamity breaks free from its sealed jar—and Tae-Ung is forced to jump off a roof to avoid a horrifying fate. But death is just the beginning. Now a ghost, Tae-Ung discovers his body has been possessed by Chachaung, the legendary Shaman King of ancient Silla. As supernatural threats close in, Tae-Ung learns that his father belonged to Ryeong, a secret corporation of exorcists. To find his father, Tae-Ung must join Ryeong and enter the hidden world of the occult… where menacing myths and lethal legends lurk behind every corner.

(Source: WEBTOON)

213643.description:
Deep in the Winter Forest, the evil and powerful witch, Despaniel, has lived alone for centuries. But her peace is interrupted when the beautiful white mare, Aileen, shows up at her door with a wounded rider. Despaniel happily gives Aileen shelter and lets the injured rider stay after he passes a test of will. With the barrier to the Winter Forest closed, Despaniel puts her human tenant to work and finds that living with him may not be as bad as she thought.

(Source: Tapas)

213644.description:
Bound by duty. Drawn by destiny. Childhood friends. King and Attendant. Neither should cross the line.

In the divine realm of Kakuriyo, King Madara of the Northern Bird Clan spends his days avoiding both responsibility and the search for a destined mate, much to the frustration of his loyal attendant, Sasame. As Madara's closest confidant, Sasame has spent years keeping the carefree king out of trouble. Yet beneath his unwavering loyalty lies a secret he's carried since childhood: a love he can never confess. After all, they may be childhood friends, but they are also master and servant.

But when an unexpected incident leaves the two spending a night together, everything begins to change. The next morning, Madara starts pursuing Sasame with an intensity that is impossible to ignore, throwing Sasame's carefully guarded heart into complete disarray. Can a king who refuses to settle down truly offer his heart? And can a loyal attendant dare to dream of a future where they stand not as master and servant, but as destined mates?

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

However, the more time they spend together, the more she begins to feel that something isn’t quite right. It seems as though Seo Do-Ha is hiding a secret…

Jun-Seo becomes obsessed with rescuing Seong-Cheol from his living hell, but breaking a toxic bond is never easy. As Min-Ho senses his prize slipping away, his possessive rage triggers a dangerous, high-stakes confrontation. Can Jun-Seo's fierce, protective devotion save Seong-Cheol, or will they all be dragged down by the heavy shadows of the past?

People say she's kind, but her indecisive nature, which prevents her from speaking her mind clearly, has caused her to lose both her friends and her job... "I hate myself," she thinks, lost on her way in life, when she boards a swaying train and arrives at—Hogami Station. In the countryside, where there's nothing but rice fields and the night sky, a young man named Seita reaches out to Tsumugi, who is at a loss, and she also has a gentle encounter with his grandmother, Suzu. This encounter marks the beginning of Tsumugi's life in the town of Hogami, where she lets herself be carried away by the slow pace of time. Deep in the mountains of Gangwon-do lies the Almighty Faith Church, a cult isolated from the world. Suryeon, a nun who fled domestic abuse to join the church, believes it is her only sanctuary. Then one day, she is chosen by the cult leader as a "Candidate for the Female Christ." It is a holy mission to conceive a messiah who will save everyone. Believing this, Suryeon heads to the training room to follow God's will. However, what awaits her is the completely different face of the once-gentle Father Kwon Hyuk.

"Sister, you have no right to refuse."

The touch she believed to be salvation gradually turns into commands, and the mission she believed to be faith slowly transforms into total submission. Even amidst fear and guilt, Suryeon finds herself relying on Kwon Hyuk's words, clinging to the false tenderness he offers, and slowly losing her sense of self.

In a world approaching its end, humanity has built a colossal, multi-layered city that rises high into the sky through the power of advanced technology. As the city continues to expand, its inhabitants live their lives within and around the vast structure, creating new connections and leaving behind the fruits of human endeavor.

Spanning different eras in this dying world, the story presents a series of snapshots that capture the lives, hopes, and everyday experiences of the people who inhabit the towering metropolis—a record of humanity and the traces it leaves behind.

(Source: Shinchosha, translated)

213729.description:
As soon as Do-Hyeon returned to civilian life after his military discharge, he was faced with the threat of the breakup of “Prism Noise,” the band he had been part of since high school as a composer and bassist. The trouble began when Seon-U, who appeared on the music variety show “Eco Star,” covered a Prism Noise song and the cover version ended up becoming more famous than the original. Compounding the problem, the drummer and guitarist both announced their departures one after another, ultimately bringing Prism Noise’s activities to an end. A troubled Do-Hyeon happens to find a drunk Seon-U and takes him back to his hotel…

This incident leads the two to start keeping in touch, and they become confidants who listen to each other’s worries. Upon learning of this, Jae-Hun begins to show signs of insecurity toward Do-Hyeon and Seon-U, and the conflict between Do-Hyeon and Jae-Hun, who were once a couple, escalates out of control. Eventually, Do-Hyeon and Jae-Hun end their relationship, but Do-Hyeon and Seon-U, comforting each other’s wounds, develop a deep bond.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

213730.description:
A laboratory filled with nothing but chaos and silence, devoid of any warmth. [BU-001 Experiment Commencing.] All Hui-Su wants is death.

“I don’t want to live anymore...”

One day, Seung-Hyeon, the ideal guide, appears before Hui-S, a Sentinel who has become so numb from heartless, painful acts and unwanted experiments that he can no longer feel pain or even emotions.

“So it’s you, my guide.”

Unlike the other violent guides, Seung-Hyeon treats Hui-Su with care, as if he were a fragile being, and watching him, Hu-Su begins to feel a strange emotion he’s never experienced before...

“I’ll always be by your side, so rest easy, Yeomyeong.”

"Hui-Su... Not Yeomyeong—Hu-Su. Do Hui-Su.”

With Seung-Hyeon’s arrival, colors begin to be added one by one to Hui-Su’s life, which had always been like a black-and-white film.

213749.description:
Three Key Features of the Kadokawa Manga Learning Series: “Japanese History”

1. Packed with Features to Help You Grasp the Big Picture of History
Before the main story, we include an illustrated guide that lets you see the key characteristics of each era at a glance. Furthermore, four-panel manga panels clearly explain the most important changes during each period. Reading the manga with this broader context in mind makes a world of difference in your understanding! This is our original format, not found in other publishers' history learning manga.

2. Great cover art! Engaging manga inside! That’s why kids read it on their own!
Popular illustrators—including Katsuya Kondo of Studio Ghibli, Kanon Yoshizaki of Sergeant Keroro, and Takeshi Obata of Death Note — have contributed to the cover art. Although the cover illustrators and manga artists are different, the artwork is coordinated with the cover to ensure a seamless reading experience. The art style is designed to appeal to today’s children, and the series is praised for being “enjoyed by kids just like any other manga.”

3. The latest Volume 16 covers events through 2022! With the most up-to-date content available anywhere, modern and contemporary history is covered thoroughly!
Volume 16 features the most up-to-date content available, covering events up to 2022. It depicts not only the COVID-19 pandemic and the Tokyo Olympics but also the formation of the Kishida Cabinet and the shooting of former Prime Minister Abe. It perfectly meets the growing demand for modern and contemporary history in recent years!

While going through the pain of not confessing, he graduated and went to live abroad without saying anything of it to anyone. However, upon coming back to his hometown, the two suddenly reunite. Shinogu can't resist the strong compassion and straightforward words of kindness... this was supposed to be a one-time deal. 213806.description:
Born beneath the ominous fate of the Heavenly Killing Star, destined to bring bloodshed wherever he walked, he refused to draw his sword, fearing the calamity it would bring upon the world. Though he knew the future, he chose to avert his eyes. But the price of his indifference was devastating. His clan was annihilated. His family was slaughtered. Only at death's door did he finally grasp the truth. Heaven does not punish the wicked. Karma does not exist. Justice is nothing more than a fantasy the weak cling to. The moment that realization dawned upon him, a forbidden scripture appeared before his eyes...

"Sutra of Vanquishing Darkness and Rending the Heavens."

A heaven-defying scripture born from the accumulated grudges of mankind, heaven, and earth.

"If heaven refuses to pass judgment... then I shall do it myself."

Having embraced the darkness, he returned as the Ruler of Darkness, vowing to punish every sin and bring down the sword of judgment upon this rotten world.

A Quest That Begins in the Kitchen!

Yoishi the tavernkeeper has a big problem with adventurers…because they have awful diets! One day, some rookie adventurers happen to bring back the bitter stone walnut from the dungeon, considered by many to be inedible. Hoping to find a way to incorporate it into a new dish, Yoishi taps into his knowledge of previous eras and embarks on a new culinary adventure!

(Source: Yen Press)

Long ago, demons and humans established a peace treaty and vowed to live in harmony. When Fouchen, ruler of the human kingdom Zenobi, arrives at an intertribal exchange, he finds a rookie demon soldier named Walt absentmindedly gazing at butterflies…The soldier’s distinctly un-demonic nature fascinates Fouchen, who decides to bring Walt to his castle! But this king has always gotten everything he ever wanted—will his newest plaything meet the same fate as all the others?

(Source: Yen Press)

"Would you love me even if I was a massive pervert?"

Things are going well for popular stripper Nao, both at work and in his love life. He is dating Takayuki, a handsome office worker, and one day at his place it finally looks like things are going to get hot and heavy for the first time...! But Nao is hiding a secret... the fact that he actually really, really loves sex! Having been rejected repeatedly for this in his past, Nao decides he's going to keep that part of him hidden this time. But can he?! An erotic comedy starring a sweet, loving boyfriend and a devoted stripper!

213853.description:
Kang Hyeon-Su, who got dumped after asking his girlfriend for a prostate massage. Hyeon-Su, a dopamine addict, was wondering if there was anyone who could satisfy his desires when he happened to run into Kwon Seo-Hyeok, a college junior who had come to his company to request a remodeling project. As the two shared drinks during their long-awaited reunion, they naturally ended up at Seo-Hyeok’s place...

What Hyeon-Su encountered there was none other than a walk-in closet filled with “adult toys”?! His initial shock was short-lived, and as Hyeon-Eu showed interest, Seo-Hyeok, as if he’d been waiting for this moment, made a suggestive remark.

“I collected all of this to share with you, Senior.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213854.description:
A private spa where even getting an appointment is as difficult as plucking a star from the sky. Ha-Yeon visited the spa run by her first love, Tae-Yun, with a flutter in her heart, but he was nowhere to be seen. Just as she lay face-down on the treatment table, putting her disappointment aside, Tae-Yun appeared, his deep, low voice echoing in her ears.

“Excuse me.”

Before she had a chance to refuse, Tae-Yun’s firm hands dug deep into the inner thighs, and the sound of wet friction echoed through the quiet room. Hae-Yeon teetered precariously between shame and pleasure…

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213855.description:
Lee Ru-Han, who cares about nothing but money, has made escaping his semi-basement apartment his life’s greatest goal. One day, he receives an unexpected offer from his older sister: if he temporarily takes care of a chameleon for two weeks, she’ll cover his moving expenses. The night after taking in this unwelcome creature, Ru-Han wakes up from the intense heat to find a huge, unfamiliar man standing right in front of him...

No way... Could that giant spouting nonsense right in front of me actually be that chameleon?!

“Master, it’s really hot down here. I want to get inside you, Ru-Han...”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213856.description:
There are many ways to describe the relationship between Yu Mu-Gueon and Go Seo-Won. From childhood neighbors who lived next door, to seniors and juniors at the same high school, to coworkers at the same high school, and even as lovers. But the happiness that seemed like it would last forever was short-lived.

“Seo-Won, don’t push me away. Don’t hate me—you still love me, right?”

Mu-Gyeon, who had been wagging his tail playfully, announces their breakup just before their 1,000th day together, and a rift begins to form between them...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: My Puppy's Separation Anxiety Recovery Story

213857.description:
Ju Yi-Hyeon, the sole heir to the Juseong Group. On the very day his father, the chairman, goes missing, he manifests as a fervent Omega. Intending to hide his nature for the rest of his life, Yi-Hyeon urges Jun-Seong, his personal assistant who has been by his side since childhood, to embrace him as an Alpha and conceive a child with him...

As their relationship takes an unexpected turn, another Alpha, Hae-Won, appears, making the situation even more complicated.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213858.description:
Kang Hae-Yeong is a die-hard anti-fan of Lee Hyeon, the lead singer of a popular band. He spends his days following Lee Hyeon’s every move and picking fights with him—a truly pathetic existence. Then one day, he finds himself drawn to a stranger with a voice similar to Lee Hyeon’s and ends up having a one-night stand with him... But this guy... now that he looks at him, it’s not just his voice that’s similar—he’s Lee Hyeon himself, isn’t he?!

“If you were going to write something like that... you should at least tell me if you really hated me that much.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213859.description:
Jin Kyung-Tae enjoys toying with celebrities he finds attractive and then discarding them. His attention is drawn once again to Ryu Tae-On, a rookie actor. Just as the groundwork is finished and he’s about to have his way with Tae-On, Kyung-Tae loses consciousness. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself locked up in an unfamiliar place. And something feels off. There was a third person watching Kyung-Tae from where he was being held captive...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213862.description:
While everyone else was reincarnating as beautiful women and adorable animals, she somehow ended up as a gloomy monster living in the male lead’s wardrobe. Worse, she was supposed to be the very monster that tormented him. According to the original story, he should’ve been terrified of her. But instead, he told her that her horns were beautiful, gave her a name, and even asked her to stay with him at night. To him, she was no longer just a monster. She was his monster.

(Source: WEBTOON)

213863.description:
Jin-U used to make video games. Now he's spent a century in another world, where the mysterious Blight is slowly swallowing it whole. Jin-U comes up with a desperate plan: turn the dying world into a video game. To people on Earth, Arsilan Saga is the most realistic VR MMORPG ever made. But the monsters are real, the NPCs are real, and the apocalypse is coming. Can Jin-U convince Earth's gamers to save a world they think is fantasy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

213865.description:
It should’ve been the end for the young Queen Etoile. When her beloved husband, Isar, cuts her down as the enemy invades, it seems she is destined for a miserably short reign. Instead, she awakens five years in the past. Armed with knowledge of what’s to come, she now has the ultimate opportunity: fix her mistakes, take back everything that was stolen from her, and enact sweet revenge on her would-be betrayers! The powers that be won’t let an upstart royal act with impunity, however. Malicious forces attack from every angle, and it soon becomes clear that Etoile isn’t the only one that remembers the past. Can Etoile tame the flow of time and find true happiness? Or is she doomed to the fate that has already once consumed her?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

213866.description:
Saving a cat-shaped plastic bag from certain death was not how Saki Osanai thought she’d go out. At least she’s got a wish out of it, and this time around, she won’t spend her life being looked down on—literally or figuratively. She’ll take a body that could knock any man off his feet. The gods are happy to oblige. Reborn as petite as ever, Saki—now called Satie—quickly learns her power lies not in the toweringly tall beauty she longed to have but instead in a stat buff that can take any enemy out. Worst of all, the god of the underworld warns she’s under a curse of eternal youth, one she’ll never be free of so long as she continues to repeat the mistakes of her past life. If she wants to break the curse keeping her down (and short), she’ll need to put herself out there in a way she never dared try before. With a trusty hellhound to spoil, true love to find, and empires to conquer, this young maiden won’t let anyone stand in her way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

213868.description:
Once feared as the kingdom’s legendary assassin, Zach “the Shadow” has abandoned his bloody past and now lives a quiet life as a priest of a rural church. There, he raises orphaned children and teaches them everything he knows: discipline, wisdom, and the combat skills to build a life outside the church walls. When one of his beloved students—Emilia—returns with burdens she can’t conceal, Zach knows he can no longer hide and wait. Stealth and shadow are familiar aides as he begins a secret investigation into the troubles that haunt her. But while Father Zach may be content to fade back into the shadows, Emilia has other plans for the humble priest. She won’t stop until she drags him into the light—and reveals just how respected he should be!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
