213869.description:
Meet Martina, a brilliant young girl with one all-consuming obsession: books. She’s already devoured every last volume in the commoners’ library, and the last place left with unread material is the royal library inside the palace itself. There’s just one tiny problem...only civil servants are allowed inside. Naturally, she does the only logical thing: aces the civil service exam and lands herself a job at the palace! But Martina’s dream of open access to books galore won’t come so easily. An unusual surge of monster attacks is threatening the kingdom, and the General Affairs Office where civil servants work stands at the epicenter of the resultant chaos. Loving the written word won’t be enough—this rookie will have to use her book smarts to travel the world and defeat powerful enemies if she wants a quiet life of reading. With a photographic memory and a brain like no other, Martina might just be the key to saving them all.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

213870.description:
Lady Lettie just wants to keep her subjects under her self-proclaimed “wicked” reign. Every day, she goes out to do the most evil biddings imaginable in her little countryside domain. What does she care if her exorbitant spending benefits the local economy, or if her special power to sound out others’ weaknesses helps them grow as people? Then one day, a surprise comes knocking when her new subject shares a grand revelation: He’s actually the kingdom’s deposed prince, and he needs her help to retake the throne. Knowing she couldn’t live out her idyllic life of tyranny if the kingdom were to fall, she agrees—but only because he’d be helpless without her, of course! She’ll do whatever it takes. She’ll say whatever needs to be said. To win back her peace, she’ll even go against her very nature and aid the wretched citizenry. And if this sweet-talking prince doesn’t stop prattling about her virtuous heart, she’ll show him just how wicked of a lady she can be too!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

"Areas" are mysterious spaces beyond human comprehension, scattered throughout the world. A boy named Mark ventures alone into one such Area, "The Beckoning Mist," a place from which it is said no one ever returns...

213884.description:
In a kingdom ruled by vampires lived two princely brothers. The older was exceptional, while the younger never seemed to measure up. But after the old king passed away, it was the younger prince who was chosen as his successor...?! And as it turns out, the older brother absolutely adores his little brother...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

213885.description:
"Any vampire who eats a human will be killed by the Velmorias..."

To marry his vampire girlfriend, Yuto decides to become a vampire himself. Just as he thinks it's time to cue the wedding bells, she tells him there's one absolute rule he must never break...?! Meeting the most feared sister-and-brother duo in the vampire world is about to throw his life into chaos!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

213887.description:
Han-Se began streaming as an adult broadcaster to rebel against a life that forced him to follow a predetermined path. Every night, he becomes “BJ Rabbit Peach,” receiving both insults and generous donations from anonymous viewers. To celebrate his first anniversary on the platform, Han-Se puts his first night up for auction among viewers, and the auction closes in an instant at the astronomical price of 1 billion won. The person who won BJ Rabbit Peach’s first night was none other than a well-known loyal viewer, “Breathing Werewolf.” Seeing him, who looked exactly like the alpha from his imagination, Han-Se couldn’t control his trembling heart. Avoiding the viewers watching the first-anniversary broadcast, he quietly whispered to him, “...Actually, this is my first time having sex.” Will BJ Rabbit Peach’s 1st-anniversary broadcast actually go off without a hitch?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

The protagonist, who became so obsessed with being a military otaku that he became a soldier and died in combat, is lucky enough to successfully reincarnate in another world. Hoping to succeed as a military man once again in his second life, he becomes a knight, but the world he reincarnated into is a chastity-reversed world where men are sexually targeted...!? Armed with modern military knowledge and aiming to rise in this other world, what assails the protagonist are beautiful girls with all kinds of fetishes who are only after his body! Will he be able to grasp glory while fending them off...?

(Source: Mag Garden, translated)

Nam Gyu-Hyeok is versatile, exceptionally handsome, and wealthy. But even this seemingly perfect man has one fatal flaw. He’s still a virgin. One day, the “Fairy of Big Ones” appears before him.

“I am the Fairy of Big Ones! I’ve come to save your dick! "

And so, the fairy’s lesson in losing his virginity begins, and Gyu-Hyeok, almost forced into it, even resorts to using a sex toy to gradually learn “how to use his penis”… But something feels off. This sensation is far too vivid to be coming from a simple toy. Is this… really just an ordinary sex toy?

(Souce: MrBlue, translated)
synonyms: I Came to Save Your Pepper!

213892.description:
Dane, who grew up in an orphanage run by the church, felt a deep sense of guilt and unease during his daily prayers because his personal traits went against church doctrine. One day, pirates raided the village, and overnight he was sold into slavery in the Northern Kingdom. As a slave, he was forced to serve the master of the household—the warrior Astor. As time passed, Dane gradually grew accustomed to caring for Astor’s family, and he began to develop an inappropriate attachment to his master…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

213893.description:
The strongest assassin, known by the name "Killer Bee," dies in a reckless quest for revenge after his little sister is murdered. But his soul does not disappear. Instead, he is reincarnated as Liese, the villainess of an otome game. To defy the cruel fate that demands Liese die in every single route, the strongest assassin takes up the blade once more in his second life.

(Source: Overlap, translated)

213894.description:
In an alternate world where people can turn their〈desires〉into magic. Particularly strong magicians, known as the〈Adept〉, are tasked with protecting the world from threats.

Konoe, a man who was reincarnated into this world, lives with the trauma of his past life and has become distrustful of others. His disillusion grows as he trains to become an〈Adept〉, his disillusion not going away even after becoming an〈Adept〉.

However, following an encounter with a sick woman named Telnerica, his life changes, seeing Telnerica as filling the void that has long existed in his heart.

213895.description:
One ordinary morning, an average high school boy named Asahi Hirakawa turns on the TV in the living room as he always does. The news begins airing a report from a hot spring, and it seems like another completely ordinary day is about to begin. That is, until a topless female reporter appears on screen...

Asahi soon discovers that society's views on male and female chastity have been completely reversed. Though bewildered at first, he tries his best to adapt to this upside-down world. Then, one of the most popular girls in his class, Riria Sotogahama, confides in him that she has no experience with men...

"Hirakawa-kun! Please! Just let me do it once!"

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

In his previous life, he died a virgin. In another world, he is reborn as Grave, the villainous noble of an eroge. Determined to build a harem, he soon remembers that Grave is destined to be killed just a few years later. Can he escape his doomed fate and create the harem of his dreams? A fantasy packed with action, fanservice, and harem antics begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

“Date me for 20,000 won an hour.”

Cha Do-Hyeon is a poor college student. One day, he received an absurd proposal from Lee Sa-Na, a junior in his department. Should he accept this girl’s proposal to find a suitable spot on campus to bury a body? Everything seemed suspicious, but for Do-Hyeon, who had just been fired from his part-time job, it was an offer too sweet to refuse!

“It really pays to have money, doesn’t it?”

“Keep those thoughts to yourself!”

A suspicious “dating-for-hire” service between a woman who has nothing but money and a man who has nothing but no money.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

213898.description:
Mark Stuart had realized something terrifying: he had been reincarnated as the mid-boss in a game! In the original game, he was fated to be condemned by his daughter, Forsina, who was known as the “Ice Maiden.”　Reflecting on his past coldness toward her, he resolves to change his fate by earning her affection. Through his thoughtfulness and his actions as a duke, his daughter begins to regain her love and trust in her father, but he ends up going too far, and her love becomes overwhelmingly heavy, putting him again in danger of getting condemned...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Vice-Captain Arabel of the Holy Knights Order has been earning resentment from many townsfolks for abusing her power to commit all kinds of evil deeds. She was extorting a shop as usual, when she discovers a choker that boosts her overall performance. She hears that it has a side effect of slightly increasing ones sexual desire though, but Arabel wears it regardless without much thought…

213910.description:
Kang Tae-Seo works multiple part-time jobs to pay off the debt his father left behind. As poverty slowly engulfs him, Tae-Seo thinks of a certain man. The son of South Korea’s most powerful chaebol family. And his first love from high school, Lee Seo-Hyeon. On a day when his only consolation was that his younger sister Min-Seo, unlike him, was doing well in college, Tae-Seo, feeling overwhelmed by a loan shark’s notice that interest rates were going up, sends a text to a number that might no longer be in service.

[Can you lend me some money?]

“Sure. I’ll give you 10 million won every time we sleep together.”

And so, Tae-Seo gives himself to Seo-Hyeon, the heir to the very corporation that drove his father to his death.

“Father, she dared to harbor lustful thoughts toward my brother.”

The horrific scar on her leg, left by a fire when she was a child. Elia, the abbot’s lame daughter, lived as a shadow, shunned by everyone. That is, until her father brought home a mysterious boy he had found in a snowfield. Isaac, her stepbrother, as dazzling as a blessing from God, suddenly burst into her lonely daily life. Her desperate prayer for a “family” that would love her had, before she knew it, twisted into a longing directed toward her brother…

“I confess the sin of shamelessly craving my brother; judge this sinner according to Your will.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Popular GV actor Taifeng Xue always has a hard time getting into the mood during shoots because he’s easily distracted by people around him. The director, who’s supposed to be in charge of the set, keeps calling “cut,” which only makes him feel even more out of character. Today, when he really doesn’t want to work overtime, will the shoot go smoothly so he can wrap up early and head home?

Mitsushiba is a cool and capable salesman who works for a printing company. Known for his good looks and great smell, he's popular with the ladies at the office! But he's only got eyes for Shirase, one of the junior employees at their printing factory. Shirase's quick to shoot down any work requests he disagrees with, but he melts like butter when he gets a little drunk. It also doesn't hurt that he's downright adorable! In her reborn life, Chloe Miller faces a hellish start – her luck has been stolen, she's been driven out of her home, and she's the entertainment world's most hated star. Undaunted, Chloe takes a job as a bodyguard for a mysterious new boss, using the opportunity to plot her comeback. Determined to make money and get revenge, she re-enters the cutthroat entertainment industry. But soon, an unexpected twist emerges – her boss, Luke Wilson’s true identity is revealed to be an ancient man who's traveled to the modern day. And he seems to have developed feelings for her...

(Source: WebComics)

213942.description:
In a world forever changed by the Great Cataclysm that reshaped the entire globe... Seo Jio, an ordinary art teacher, dies in a sudden fire, only to awaken trapped inside a portrait as a painting himself. Within the world of the portrait, Jio gains omnipotent abilities. He can create life and even open gateways to other dimensions. As he travels across countless dimensions, Jio encounters people bound by fate and uses his newfound abilities to help them overcome the trials before them. But with every dimension he crosses and every incident he resolves, he draws closer to uncovering the truth shrouding his own death…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

213943.description:
How many days have passed now? It’s as if I’ve been soaking in hot water this whole time—.

Best-selling author of the social media era, Moegara × Tokushige Kawakatsu, the acclaimed manga artist selected as No. 1 in “Kono Manga wo Yome! 2025” An unprecedented collaboration gives birth to an unparalleled fantasy tale!!

When you make the blood in your entire body boil in scalding hot water, things that should be invisible become visible—. Kazuo Kato lives in Tokyo as a writer. Not only did the mentor who had taken him under his wing die in an accident three weeks ago, but recently, the girlfriend he’d been living with also left him. As he worked himself to the bone and led a desolate life, he gradually began to see strange visions. One day, a friend who sensed something was wrong came to visit, and Kazuo was finally swallowed up by the hallucinations—only to find himself at the inn in Yufuin that had belonged to his mentor. Is this a dream, or is it reality? What bizarre fate awaits Kazuo?

(Source: Gunzou, translated)

213944.description:
This is a gem of a coming-of-age manga that depicts the setbacks, losses, and rebirth experienced over the course of ten years by a female substitute English teacher, who left her high school a decade ago following a certain incident, and the students who were in her classroom at the time. It’s a poignant story that also gives readers the courage to take that next step forward. Kirinji’s classic song “Aliens” provides the soundtrack as the characters strive toward their dreams, give up on them and fall into despair, and then begin new chapters in their lives.

This work was originally written by author Moegara as the screenplay for the Hulu Original drama of the same name, created specifically for adaptation to the screen. It was adapted into a manga by Mari Okazaki simultaneously with the drama’s production.

(Source: SPA!BOOKS, translated)

213945.description:
At the age of eight, Lucian is forced to "marry" an invisible ghost and live in her haunted mansion. Taking pity on Lucian, the ghost secretly cooks and cleans for him, only to discover he can suddenly see her! Once they're closer, Lucian names his ghost bride "Ria" and promises to officially wed her someday. But Lucian is later revealed to be a prince, and the two of them are torn apart shortly after. Years later, the little groom returns as a powerful emperor, ready to sweep his ghost bride off her feet at last.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Korean.

I Took a Job from the Villain Boss

213948.description:
Ja-Yun has willingly agreed to become her mentor Cheong-Un’s weapon in his quest for revenge. As Ja-Yun participates in the Emperor’s concubine selection ceremony, the Crown Prince appears, turning the entire situation upside down. The Crown Prince, who suspects Ja-Yun’s true identity and stands in her way, and Master Cheong-Un, who can only watch from afar. Amid a journey of vengeance to bring down the Emperor, a bitter and brutal love triangle involving these three begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: At the End of the Blue Dawn

213950.description:
Lim Mun-Yeong runs into his high school first love, Yeon Hae-Jeong, in an unexpected place. And not just anywhere—as an executive at a major corporation and a janitor at that same company. It’s been ten years since he gave up on his unrequited love. Whether Hae-Jeong recognized Mun-Yeong, who was hiding his name and pretending not to know him or not, Hae-Jeong drags him around, making him do odd jobs under all sorts of childish pretexts. Although Hae-Jeong’s strange behavior, as if he somehow remembered him, made him uncomfortable, Mun-Yeong didn’t care because he no longer had any feelings for him.

“You don’t still like me, do you, Lim Mun-Yeong?”

That is, until he heard those words from Hae-Jeong.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

213951.description:
His only hope is his own wits! Kang Cheol-Jung, once an ordinary high school student, woke up one day to find himself trapped in a sealed room he’d never seen before. In his confusion, he searched his surroundings and discovered an old MP3 player. A message left on the MP3 revealed the shocking truth: he had been poisoned and had only three hours left to live. Kang Cheol-Jung, who had always been a mystery puzzle enthusiast, draws on the deductive skills he’d honed over the years to search for clues and try to escape the locked room. But theory and reality are two different things. After making one mistake after another, he eventually finds himself in a desperate situation where the poison has spread and he’s coughing up blood. What will be the final clue that catches his eye?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

213953.description:
I finally got a job thanks to a referral from a senior at school! The guys are a bit intimidating, and sometimes it's tough because there's so much work, but they pay well, so it seems like a good company. However, the older sister I used to work with until recently hasn't been around since last week...! Could she have gone to the 'weekend farm' the guys talk about?

Ever since the baby mountain spirit, his only friend in childhood, had left him, Kal had been hunting down and killing every deer he could find, believing them to be the mountain spirit’s incarnation. He believed in a legend that said if a species in the mountains were wiped out, the mountain spirit would descend and restore that species. After several years of focusing solely on hunting deer without ever encountering the Mountain Spirit, a handsome man with fair skin appeared and completely turned Kal’s life upside down...

“Fifty. That’s the number of my children you’ve killed. And that’s the number of my children you’ll bear.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213965.description:
Shizuka has officially broken up with her boyfriend, and she and Takehito now meet up regularly for sex at her place. They both enjoy each other’s company a lot, but are things just about sex between them? Maybe there’s more to it?

The friendship between a girl and a boy began when they skipped class together. Though they differ in personality, background, and dreams for the future, the two grow closer despite their differences.

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

213970.description:
Due to a plot hatched by the Great Spirit and Seol Ji-Han, the head of the Hyunmu Clan, the Cheongryong Clan is wiped out overnight. Eun Do-Hyeon, the head of the Cheongryong Clan, took up his sword to seek revenge against the two spirits, but was taken prisoner. To make matters worse, he finds himself bound by an unbreakable master-servant contract with his sworn enemy, Seol Ji-Han...

“You’re my slave now. You mustn’t question your master’s orders.”

“Seol Ji-Han, I’ll never forgive you, even if it costs me my life...!”

Eun Do-Hyeon cannot deny that, despite wanting to kill his sworn enemy, he finds himself increasingly drawn to him. And as time goes on, he begins to notice Seol Ji-Han’s strange behavior.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

213971.description:
A small neighborhood in Seoul, 2004. Jeong-Hui, a child called a “monster” simply because his whole body is red Despite being teased by others, Jeong-Hui, whose heart is clearer and purer than anyone else’s, spends his days running all sorts of errands for his stepfather and mother. Then, at the age of eight, when Jeong-Hui goes to school for the first time, he realizes: My family is… somehow strange.

(Source: Naver, translated)

213972.description:
Hye-Jin became a hikikomori after being brutally dumped by her first love. Now that she’s 26, she wants to finally break free from a “life that’s falling behind everyone else’s”! Dreaming of a normal everyday life, she started a part-time job at a gym. But it turns out there was a “helper” waiting for her as she took her first step toward this challenge? Four men gather around the confused Hye-Jin. A full set of romantic entanglements with these four men as grueling as her workouts is about to begin…?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Tae-Hee is the governor's demure daughter during the day and a merciless dominatrix at night. When the lustful ghost king threatens to keep seducing the women in the village unless he's offered a maiden as his bride, Tae-Hee acts as bait to take him down. With the help of a famous exorcist and her own experiences conquering men, she thinks she'll get a good crack at punishing her arrogant husband. But once they're dragged into the world of ghosts, a rocky path lies ahead of them. Will Tae-Hee's determination and spicy expertise be enough to defeat her enemy?

(Source: Tappytoon)

213994.description:
Despite the abuse she suffered at the hands of her parents and partners, Didi was unable to break free from these relationships due to chronic anxiety and a sense of deprivation. Then one day, she meets the kind and thoughtful Yu-Jin and finally finds the courage to escape her abusive relationships. But just because love has begun doesn’t mean her wounds will disappear. Didi, an anxious person who constantly craves reassurance of love, and Yu-Jin, an avoidant person who gradually distances himself, unable to cope with those feelings. As they grow closer, the two become increasingly unstable. Will they truly be able to love each other? And will Didi be able to save herself and grow?

A emotional drama that delicately yet sharply portrays the real-life romance between an anxious woman and an avoidant man.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: To Me, Who Will Shake Tomorrow as Well

213995.description:
Geung returned to Korea, putting an end to his life abroad, which he had embarked on with lofty dreams. When he returned home, dragging his weary body and mind, he was greeted by his father, Byeol who leaned on a cane and spoke with a slur. The daily life of this ordinary family, who had lived diligently like everyone else, crumbled in the face of a rare disease that struck one day: Lou Gehrig’s disease.

A disability? No cure? We’ve just been living our lives to the best of our ability. Why did this have to happen to us of all people?

Bullying, dropping out of school, his father’s ALS, and endless self-loathing. Faced with countless misfortunes, the family is shaken, and Geung, too, hits rock bottom. But in the end, they decide to get back on their feet.

“We’re still alive today, aren’t we? We’re all growing steadily, yet magnificently.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

213996.description:
I’m changing. Wasn’t mermaid meat supposed to be the elixir of immortality?

In the late Goryeo period, as a noble girl fled from war, the moment she ate mermaid meat to survive, the fates of her twin sister, the villagers where she had newly settled, and a man she came to believe was her destined partner were swept into a turbulent whirlwind…

A girl’s passionate obsession clashes with a man’s burning desire for revenge!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

213997.description:
"The pure, smooth pebbles of life. You have to hold them tightly in your hands."

“Peanut Diary,” an illustrated essay by Jeong Jji, an artist who writes and draws from the heart. The joys and sorrows, anxieties and consolations encountered as the seasons pass. The story of Peanut, who lives each day even with a fragile heart, discovers moments in life as pure as pebbles even amidst sorrow, and believes that tomorrow will surely be better. Yet these are records of everyday life that mirror our own where we want to lie down at the slightest chance, and live by laughing and crying over the little things.

"Peanut Diary Special" brings together the episodes most beloved by readers. We invite you into Peanut’s world, filled with solid sincerity, delightful humor, empathy, and warmth!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
